deliverables.description: A written variance analysis and reconciliation report addressed to officials, presenting the differences between approved budget and actual spending, their magnitude and composition, and recommended changes to reconcile those differences.

information_nodes.description: The approved budget figures for the relevant organizational units, programs, or spending categories, broken down consistently with the spending records.
The actual spending records for the same organizational units, programs, or categories and the same scope and period as the approved budget.
Organizational rules, policies, and reconciliation criteria that govern permissible budget adjustments, transfers, or corrective actions available to reconcile variances.

Computed variances between approved budget and actual spending by category, unit, or program, including direction and magnitude of each difference and their relative contribution to the total variance.
Relevant explanations, supporting documentation, or operational context accounting for the identified spending differences, where such records are available.

Assessment of which variances require reconciliation action and what specific changes to budget allocations, spending controls, or adjustments are appropriate, based on the magnitude and nature of the differences and applicable organizational rules.
Requirements and preferences of the officials who are the audience for the report, including the level of detail, focus areas, and decision support they need.

work_objective: Prepare a written report that analyzes the variance between an approved budget and actual spending, and communicates recommended changes to reconcile the differences to an organization's officials.

deliverables.description: A concise project progress status summary reporting the project's schedule position against deadlines, conformance to applicable standards, and cost position against cost targets, with an overall progress assessment and any variances identified during monitoring.

information_nodes.description: The approved project plan defining planned milestones, deadlines, applicable standards or acceptance criteria, and cost targets for the project across its planning through implementation phases.
Current project progress records: milestone completion status, actual activity dates, and work completed to date against planned work.
Cost records showing actual expenditures incurred and committed costs to date against the approved budget.
Quality and standards evidence: results of tests, reviews, or acceptance checks, and observed properties of produced work products relative to the applicable standards and acceptance criteria.
Comparison of actual schedule progress and milestone completion against planned deadlines, identifying schedule variances and the current deadline status.
Comparison of actual cost expenditures to date against cost targets, identifying cost variances and the current budget status.
Assessment of observed quality and test results against the applicable standards and acceptance criteria, identifying conformance or non-conformance.

Overall assessment of whether the project is meeting deadlines, standards, and cost targets, with a judgment on the significance of identified variances and any areas requiring the supervisor's attention.

work_objective: Monitor a software project's progress from planning through implementation by reconciling its actual schedule, quality/standards conformance, and cost performance against the approved plan, and produce a status summary that reports progress against deadlines, standards, and cost targets.
